claims: Cloudflare released a Claude skill that performs a full security audit; it is a full harness, not a single prompt
For each agent that finds a gap, another agent is spun up to try to disprove it; fresh agents then do a final pass
On his multi-module app it spun up ~130 agents: 43 to hunt vulnerabilities, 37 to validate findings, 40 to verify everything

On-screen workflow stats: 1h 04m 49s, 134 agents, 9.2M tokens; phases Resume 3/3, Hunt 43/43, Validate 37/37, Probe 8/8, Verify 40/40, Report 2/3; report agents ran on Sonnet 5.5 at ~156k-199k tokens each
Found a few low and medium vulnerabilities; easy patches
Disclaimer: uses a ton of tokens, about 10% of his weekly 20x Max plan
Recommendation: run this audit every time you touch code or before every release
how_to_steps: Install Cloudflare's security-audit-skill in Claude Code

security-audit-skill README: 'The skill runs a structured audit in six phases: 1. Reconnaissance -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in architecture.md and coverage-ledger.json. 2. Coverage-led hunting -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps. 3. Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it. 4. Structured output -- write confirmed, needs_validation, and rejected records to findings.json and validate them against report-schema.json. 5. Independent record verification -- fresh agents verify final source claims... 6. Target-neutral reporting -- REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL..., NEEDS-VALIDATION.md from records and coverage ledger. The parent runs validate-... after creating the ledger and... update. It runs validate-... again after every Phase...'

Ducktate 'Connect AI' settings: 'Let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client read and write your notes. Copy one block and paste it into your client.' relevance.why: Security is Haji's most-liked non-build topic (login gaps, AppBully, Strix, legal checklist). A free, vendor-backed, multi-agent audit skill that self-disproves findings is a strong fit for a solo founder with no security team. The cost warning (~9M tokens, ~10% of a 20x weekly quota) is critical practical data.

implement_score.why: Install the skill, run it once per app on a release branch (budget ~1 hour and a chunk of weekly quota; run overnight or in a cloud session), patch confirmed findings, then schedule it pre-release. Pair with Strix/AppBully results. Main cost is tokens, not Haji's time.
